caption:
Standing just 4 miles from a Starship launch, this is what it actually looks and sounds like. The rocket is the tallest and most powerful ever built, and even people who watch launches every week say nothing prepares you for it in person.

Starship is the vehicle SpaceX is building to one day carry people to Mars. Watching it go to orbit from this close is the kind of moment that makes a veteran rocket watcher forget to act cool.

The person filming has seen more launches than most people see sunsets. He still grabbed his phone.
